risks.title: NAV computation error due to stale security prices
risks.description: Incorrect or stale vendor price feeds may flow into the daily NAV computation for open-ended schemes, producing an erroneous published NAV and triggering investor compensation and SEBI reporting obligations.

risks.title: Portfolio concentration breach in mid-cap schemes
risks.description: Single-issuer and sector exposure in mid-cap equity schemes may drift beyond SEBI limits and internal investment restrictions during market rallies, exposing schemes to concentration losses and regulatory action.

risks.title: Liquidity shortfall in debt schemes under redemption stress
risks.description: Concentrated institutional redemptions in corporate bond schemes during credit events may force distressed sales, breaching the 10% redemption-payout timeline and harming remaining unitholders.

risks.title: Credit default of a portfolio issuer below investment grade
risks.description: Downgrade or default of a held issuer may require side-pocketing, valuation markdowns and investor communication under SEBI segregated-portfolio norms.

risks.title: Trade settlement failure with clearing counterparty
risks.description: Failed equity or debt settlements due to counterparty or custodian process breaks may cause funding costs, penal charges and exchange disciplinary action.

risks.title: Dealing desk order entry error
risks.description: Fat-finger or wrong-scheme order entry at the dealing desk may create unintended exposures requiring error-account absorption and board reporting.

risks.title: Ransomware attack on transfer agency interface systems
risks.description: A ransomware compromise of servers hosting the RTA interface could halt subscription/redemption processing and exfiltrate investor PII, invoking the SEBI Cyber Security & Cyber Resilience Framework reporting timelines.

risks.title: Obsolete fund accounting platform version
risks.description: The fund accounting system runs a vendor version approaching end-of-support; unpatched vulnerabilities and missing regulatory patches raise operational and compliance exposure.

risks.title: Investor transaction processing errors at service centres
risks.description: Manual errors in investor folio maintenance and transaction capture may cause wrong allotments, delayed redemptions and complaints escalating to SEBI SCORES.

risks.title: Mis-selling risk in new fund offer distribution
risks.description: Distributors may position a sectoral NFO to unsuitable retail investors, breaching suitability norms and attracting SEBI advertising-code scrutiny.

risks.title: Key person dependency in quantitative research team
risks.description: Departure of the lead quantitative analyst would leave proprietary models undocumented and unmaintained, degrading investment process quality.

risks.title: Non-compliance with SEBI advertisement code in digital campaigns
risks.description: Social-media performance claims may omit mandated disclosures, breaching the SEBI advertising code for mutual funds.

risks.title: RTA service disruption affecting investor servicing
risks.description: A prolonged outage or exit of the registrar & transfer agent would halt folio servicing; dependency is concentrated in a single vendor.

risks.title: Primary data centre unavailability beyond recovery objectives
risks.description: A regional grid failure or facility event could exceed the 4-hour RTO for NAV-critical systems if DR replication lags persist.

risks.title: Front-running and personal trading violations
risks.description: Access persons may trade ahead of scheme transactions in breach of SEBI insider trading regulations and the AMC code of conduct.

risks.title: Interest rate shock impact on duration-heavy debt schemes
risks.description: A rapid parallel shift in the yield curve would mark down long-duration gilt schemes beyond tolerance bands communicated to investors.

risks.title: Fraudulent redemption through compromised investor credentials
risks.description: Account takeover of investor online accounts could route redemptions to mule bank accounts before detection.

risks.title: Inaccurate expense ratio disclosure in scheme documents
risks.description: TER computation errors could flow into scheme information documents and factsheets, breaching disclosure norms.

risks.title: Legacy fax-based transaction acceptance
risks.description: Residual fax-based transaction acceptance at two branches lacked audit trail; channel decommissioned in June 2026.

risks.title: Skills shortage in fund accounting during peak NFO periods
risks.description: Simultaneous NFO launches strain the fund accounting team; single-day leave clusters have previously delayed NAV sign-off.

riskAssessments.title: H1 2026 reassessment — NAV computation error
riskAssessments.rationale: Price-feed tolerance checks and the four-eyes NAV sign-off operated without exception through H1; residual likelihood reduced from 3 to 2.

riskAssessments.title: July 2026 stress reassessment — debt liquidity
riskAssessments.rationale: Liquidity coverage in two corporate bond schemes fell below the internal floor during June redemptions; residual stays at 15, breaching the Fund Management appetite threshold of 12 — escalated.

riskAssessments.title: Post-penetration-test reassessment — ransomware exposure
riskAssessments.rationale: External penetration test confirmed two exploitable paths into the RTA interface DMZ; EDR rollout only 70% complete. Residual 15 breaches the Operations appetite of 12.

riskAssessments.title: Initial assessment — fraudulent redemption via account takeover
riskAssessments.rationale: Initial scoring based on industry incident data and current MFA coverage of the investor portal (85% of active folios).

treatmentPlans.title: Complete EDR rollout and DMZ segmentation for RTA interface
treatmentPlans.description: Finish endpoint detection & response deployment on remaining 30% of servers, re-segment the RTA interface DMZ, and add immutable backup tier.

treatmentPlans.title: Raise liquidity buffers and pre-arranged repo lines
treatmentPlans.description: Increase liquid asset floor from 10% to 15% in the two affected schemes and establish committed repo lines with two counterparties.

treatmentPlans.title: Fund accounting platform version upgrade
treatmentPlans.description: Upgrade to vendor-supported version with regulatory patch stream; parallel-run one NAV cycle before cutover.

treatmentPlans.title: Automated stale-price detection thresholds
treatmentPlans.description: Implemented tolerance-band and stale-price flags in the pricing engine with dual-source verification for illiquid debt.

treatmentPlans.title: RTA exit-management and portability plan
treatmentPlans.description: Negotiate data-escrow and portability clauses; document a 90-day migration runbook to an alternate RTA.

treatmentPlans.title: Duration hedging via interest rate futures
treatmentPlans.description: Evaluated hedging long-duration exposure with IRF; cost-benefit rejected by Investment Committee, risk formally accepted instead.

treatmentPlans.title: Quantitative model documentation and cross-training
treatmentPlans.description: Document all proprietary models in the research knowledge base and cross-train two analysts per model family.

treatmentPlans.title: Straight-through processing for top transaction types
treatmentPlans.description: Extend STP to the five highest-volume investor transaction types, removing manual re-keying at service centres.

riskAcceptances.title: Acceptance of residual mis-selling risk after distributor controls
riskAcceptances.justification: Residual score 6 is within the Marketing & Distribution appetite of 9. Distributor certification checks, NFO suitability scripts and mystery-shopping reviews are operating effectively; further mitigation is disproportionate to exposure.

riskAcceptances.title: Acceptance of interest-rate risk in duration strategy
riskAcceptances.justification: Duration positioning is an explicit investment strategy disclosed in scheme documents. Investment Committee rejected hedging on cost-benefit grounds; risk accepted with semi-annual review.

riskAcceptances.title: Interim acceptance pending cross-training completion
riskAcceptances.justification: Requesting time-bound acceptance while the model documentation and cross-training treatment plan completes by September.

escalations.title: Appetite breach — debt scheme liquidity residual 15 vs threshold 12
escalations.notes: Raised automatically on approval of assessment RAS-2026-0002; requires CRO acknowledgement and Board Risk Committee notification.

escalations.title: Appetite breach — ransomware residual 15 vs threshold 12
escalations.notes: Acknowledged by CRO on 06 Jul; EDR completion treatment plan TRT-2026-0001 tracked weekly until residual returns within appetite.

escalations.title: KRI breach — NAV recomputation count exceeded red threshold in April
escalations.notes: Three NAV recomputations in April against a red threshold of 2. Root cause: vendor price-file format change. Resolved after tolerance-check patch on 12 May.

escalations.title: Manual escalation — complaint spike at northern service centres
escalations.notes: Investor Services reported a 40% month-on-month complaint increase concentrated in two centres; STP treatment plan accelerated.

kris.name: NAV recomputations per month
kris.description: Count of published-NAV recomputations across all schemes in the calendar month.

kris.name: Liquid assets % in corporate bond schemes
kris.description: Weighted average liquid asset percentage across corporate bond schemes.

kris.name: Failed settlements per month
kris.description: Count of trade settlements failing on contractual settlement date.

kris.name: Critical/high vulnerabilities open > 30 days
kris.description: Open critical and high severity vulnerabilities beyond the 30-day remediation SLA.

kris.name: Investor complaints per 10,000 folios
kris.description: SCORES and direct complaints normalized per ten thousand active folios.

kris.name: Single-issuer max exposure % (mid-cap schemes)
kris.description: Highest single-issuer exposure across mid-cap equity schemes against the 10% regulatory limit.

kris.name: Dealing errors per quarter
kris.description: Count of dealing-desk order errors recorded in the error account.

kris.name: DR replication lag (minutes)
kris.description: Peak asynchronous replication lag between primary and DR data centres for NAV-critical systems.
